services.name: Rental Units
services.desc: Enjoy your morning coffee on the front porch while watching the blue heron across the water or settle into the comfy living room chairs and gaze out the large picture windows. This spacious country home has three bedrooms-two with queen-sized beds; one with a twin bed. There is also a daybed with a trundle in the upstairs center room. The bathroom has a separate shower and a tub/shower combination as well as double sinks. The Farmhouse is the very definition of charm in a place where nature blooms all around you. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Welcome to the Keen Lake Boat Shed. When you’re at Keen Lake, we’ve found you can’t help wanting to explore the shoreline of our 90-acre lake! It is simply part of the Keen Lake experience. Rental options are many and varied. Find the one that is right for you and enjoy your time on the lake your way! Boats are available to rent from 8:00 AM until dusk. Rentals are subject to 6% PA state sales tax. If you have brought an electric motor, ask for a rowboat that has a current PA registration. We provide Coast Guard-approved life vests for each person in the boat. Pennsylvania Law requires that vests be worn by all children ages 12 and under.
